full_prompt_en: A square hand-drawn storybook illustration shows three backpacked children hurrying down a sharply tilted city street. The picture is angled so the pavement climbs from the lower left toward the center right, and the tall buildings lean around the running figures. A warm cream sky opens at the upper right, with loose yellow washes around a distant blue dome. At the left, crowded teal-gray facades have arched windows, balconies, doorways, and bits of ocher brick, all sketched with irregular ink lines. The largest child runs through the middle. He has spiky dark brown hair, a long nose, oversized white eyes looking up and right, an olive jacket, blue jeans, dark sneakers, and a bulky orange-brown backpack. One leg kicks backward while the other reaches forward, giving his stride an exaggerated diagonal rhythm. Behind him on the left, a smaller child in an orange top and dark trousers follows with a bag and a dark object held near the chest. On the lower right, a blond child in a purple top and dark backpack runs with one hand extended toward the street. Their faces are simple but alert, with small noses and eyes turned toward the same direction. Broken paving stones and a low greenish curb fill the lower band, their strong diagonal lines reinforcing the sense of speed. The background architecture is busy but lighter than the main figures, gradually becoming pale blue-gray silhouettes near the right horizon. Sunlight seems to enter from the bright upper right, warming hair, noses, and parts of the stone while leaving the left buildings in cooler shade. The watercolor-like color is patchy and translucent in the distance, but thicker around clothing and pavement; scratchy ink contours hold the shapes together. No lettering is readable on the buildings. The overall composition is lively and off balance on purpose, using quick lines, exaggerated movement, and warm-cool contrast to make the city feel adventurous.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘故事书插画呈现三个背着书包的孩子，急匆匆跑下明显倾斜的城市街道。画面斜转，路面从左下向右侧中央爬升，高高的建筑在奔跑人物周围倾斜。右上打开一片暖奶油色天空，远处蓝色圆顶周围有松散黄颜色洗。左侧拥挤的青灰色立面带有拱窗、阳台、门洞和几块赭色砖面，全部由不规则墨线草草勾出。最大的孩子从中央跑过。他有竖起的深棕头发、长鼻子、朝右上方看的夸张白眼睛、橄榄色外套、蓝色牛仔裤、深色运动鞋和鼓鼓的橙褐色书包。一条腿向后踢，另一条腿向前伸，让步伐形成夸张对角节奏。左后方，一名穿橙色上衣与深色裤子的小一些的孩子背着包跟上，胸前拿着一个深色物件。右下方，一名穿紫色上衣、背深色书包的金发孩子奔跑，一只手向街面伸出。他们的脸简化却警觉，小鼻子和眼睛都转向同一方向。破碎铺石与低矮绿灰色路缘填满下部色带，强烈斜线强化速度感。背景建筑繁忙却比主要人物更浅，靠近右侧远处逐渐变成浅蓝灰剪影。阳光似乎从明亮的右上方进入，温暖头发、鼻子及部分石面，让左侧建筑保持较冷阴影。水彩般色彩在远处斑驳而透明，在衣服及铺地上更厚实；粗糙的墨线轮廓把形体连在一起。建筑上没有可读文字。整体构图有意活泼而失衡，借快速线条、夸张运动和冷暖反差，让城市带有冒险气息。
style_prompt_en: The hand-drawn illustration combines scratchy dark contours with uneven watercolor-like washes. Cool teal and blue-gray establish broad receding masses, while ocher, yellow, orange, and violet accents pick out a few fast-moving focal shapes. Perspective is deliberately tilted, with strong diagonal lines and compressed overlapping forms creating momentum. Outlines wobble and break rather than following rigid geometry; tiny hatch marks and dry-brush patches give stone and fabric a lived-in surface. Distant forms lose detail in pale translucent color, while nearby shapes gain heavier line and thicker pigment. Light comes from one bright upper side, keeping the open area warm and the denser side cooler. The visual rhythm alternates crowded structural marks with a freer, brighter opening. The overall effect is playful and adventurous, with energetic draftsmanship more important than polished symmetry.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘插画把粗糙深色轮廓与不均匀的水彩般色洗结合。冷青绿与蓝灰建立宽阔后退团块，赭黄、亮黄、橙色和紫色重音则挑出少数快速运动的焦点形体。透视有意倾斜，强烈对角线与压缩重叠的形态制造动势。轮廓摇晃、断续，不服从僵硬几何；细小排线与干笔斑块让石面和布料具有生活过的表面。远处形体在浅淡透明色中失去细节，近处则得到更重线条与更厚颜料。光从明亮的上方一侧进入，让开放区域温暖，较密集一侧更冷。视觉节奏在拥挤结构痕迹与自由明亮的开口之间交替。整体效果俏皮而充满冒险感，富于能量的绘画线条比抛光般的对称更重要。
theme_en: Three backpacked children hurrying through a tilted city street
theme_zh: 三个背包孩子奔过倾斜的城市街道
name: Jeff Kinney
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
